_note: Edit effects on every Reel (pln_agent/edit_fx.py). replay: the payoff again, slowed and punched in, after the main edit. punch_in: a quick zoom on the payoff itself. sfx: an impact hit on the payoff and a whoosh into the replay, synthesised by the renderer (no third-party audio). music: beds come from the Music page (approved by ear, licence cleared for the platform; config/music.json); a licensed bed can also be listed here as {"path": "s3://...", "license": "...", "brands": [...]}. A post can switch any of these off on its page.

putt_tour._why: a putt's payoff is the ball dropping, seconds after the stroke
